question: By what means does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of the Kaula, and to whom is that claim addressed?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have come to know something by that lord's grace.
The object known is the determination of the Kaula.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula.
uncertainties: The extent of what was known prior to this grace is not specified.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula.
